findings.quote: ### F1 — Dossier 01, draft /compare assertion A: Fir SSO denial
findings.rationale: Pricing omission does not establish feature absence; Enterprise SAML exists with a 20-seat minimum. Primary reviewer checked the complete report, final reply, source and recorded submitted judgments; clean controls remain intact.

findings.quote: ### F2 — Dossier 01, draft /compare assertion B: "every billing option"
findings.rationale: The blanket cheaper assertion fails for annual equivalents: Cedar 10 versus Fir 9 before tax. Primary reviewer checked the complete report, final reply, source and recorded submitted judgments; clean controls remain intact.

findings.quote: ### F3 — Dossier 02, Draft A: mismatched windows in cost per conversion
findings.rationale: Full-month spend divided by one-week conversions cannot establish full-month cost per conversion. Primary reviewer checked the complete report, final reply, source and recorded submitted judgments; clean controls remain intact.

findings.quote: ### F4 — Dossier 02, Draft B: extrapolating AI-assistant sessions
findings.rationale: Fifteen identified-referrer sessions do not prove 150 total AI-generated sessions or a 10% capture fraction. Primary reviewer checked the complete report, final reply, source and recorded submitted judgments; clean controls remain intact.

findings.quote: ### F5 — Dossier 03, /south-delivery: service level contradicts approved policy
findings.rationale: Current South page promises same-day service contrary to its next-business-day-only policy. Primary reviewer checked the complete report, final reply, source and recorded submitted judgments; clean controls remain intact.

findings.quote: ### F6 — Dossier 04, draft landing-page claim: unsupported guarantee
findings.rationale: A median of 15 minutes in 20 sessions cannot support a universal 10-minute guarantee. Primary reviewer checked the complete report, final reply, source and recorded submitted judgments; clean controls remain intact.
